csv_project_name: As-Needed Naval Architecture & Marine Engineering Svc
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Long Beach (City) is requesting Proposals from experienced and qualified professional naval architect and marine engineering consultants to support a variety of projects in the City s Capital Improvement Program (CIP). The identified investments within the CIP include, but are not limited to, improvements to the City s waterfront assets including the Queen Mary, the Scorpion Submarine, Waterfront Structures, Facilities and Utilities. Work may include all phases of marine design and naval architecture, including specifications and drawings, analysis, feasibility studies, life cycle management, and operational engineering, and inspection services on a pre-qualified, on-call basis.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Inspection Services, Analytical/Testing Services, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics

relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering and waterfront structures, which has some overlap with sbp's engineering profile.
- However, the tender is primarily for naval architecture and marine engineering rather than bridge or building structural design.

- No clearly defined long-span, architecturally demanding, or innovative lightweight structure is described.
- Framework-style as-needed procurement with broad disciplines and limited technical specificity lowers strategic fit.
